generation_rule: deterministic stratified state construction; no duplicated cases and no learned-method labels

valid_tracking.interpretation: the target relation remains current and the stale maneuver is still useful

task_obsolescence.interpretation: the maneuver remains physically safe but no longer advances the current task

team_contention.interpretation: the maneuver remains individually useful but conflicts with a completed teammate reservation

dynamic_divergence.interpretation: physical evolution has moved the system outside the stale maneuver validity region
